content: Tana ayye! Taani teera ayfey maxetidi wurin, woyniyapenne balase mithafe ba amotidaysa demmanaw danda7iboona koshatida uraa mela gidas.
Xoossa asi biittan baawa; asa garsan suure asi dhayis. Asi ubbay asa suuthi gussanaw hokidi naagees; ubbay ba ishaa giten oykanaw kaallees.
Enta nam7u kusheti iitaba oothanaw loohidosona. Halaqinne daynni wodhaafe oychoosona; wolqara de7iya asati banta koydaba wolqan polisoosona. Enti ubbay issife pirdaa mirqidi dhaysoosona.

content.text: Enta garsan keeha geeteteysi aguntha mela;
I ba asaa seerana gallasay gakis;
Neera de7iya ne machefe ne doona naaga.
He wode na7ay ba aawa kadhees;
na7aa machiya ba azinaa aaye bolla
Asas iya soo asay morke gidana.
ta dhuman uttikoka Goday taw poo7ana.
I taw mootetidi, tabaa pirdana gakanaw,
He wode ta morkey hessa be7ana;

content: Hinteno, Isra7eele asaw, hinte katamaa gimbe dirsati diretiya gallasay yaana; he gallas hinte zaway aakana.
He gallas hinte asay hinteko simmana. Enti Asoorepe, Gibxefe, Efraxiisa shaafa heeran de7iya biittatape, haaho bessan de7iya abba gaxapenne dhoqa zumatape hinteko simmana.
Shin biittay iya bolla de7iya asaa iitatetha gaason asi bayna baysa gidana.
Neeni bazzon barka de7iya, ne laata deriya ne aradda biittan ne asaa heemma. Enti kase wodiyada Baasaneninne Galadan heemetana mela ootha.
Goday, “Hinte Gibxepe keyida wodiyada taani hintena malaalsiyaba bessaana” yaagees.
Enta wolqay gita gidikoka, kawotethati ubbay hessa be7idi yeellatana. Enti yeellatidi, banta doona oykana; enta haythay tullana.
Enti shooshadanne sa7ara gooshetiya medhetethatada biitta laaccana. Enti banta miixape kokorishe keyidi gita dagaman Godaako, nu Xoossaako, simmana; enti Godaa yayyidi daana.
Nagara ubbaa atto yaagey, attida ba asaa naaquwa taybonnay ne mela Xoossi oonee? Maarotethi nena ufaysiya gisho ne hanquwan merinaw gam7a eraka.
Neeni zaarada ne asaas qadhetasa; nu naaquwa ne tohuwan yedhasa; nu nagara abba ciimmon holaasa.
Neeni beni nu mayzatas caaqida caaquwada Abrahaamenne Yayqooba zare gidida ne asaas ne ammanetethanne ne merina siiquwa bessaana.
